stemMd: A list contains all positive multiples of 4 in increasing order except those also divisible by 6. What is the sixth number in the list?
explanationMd: Start with multiples of four and remove multiples of twelve: 4, 8, 16, 20, 28, 32, 40, … . The sixth retained number is 32. Count after exclusions rather than before them.

distractorRationale.a: This is excluded because it is divisible by six.
distractorRationale.b: This is the fifth retained number.
distractorRationale.d: This is also excluded as divisible by six.
distractorRationale.e: This is the seventh retained number.
